name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: A breadcrumb trail whose middle collapses into an expandable ellipsis, with segments that slide in and out as you navigate.

useCases: Showing where a page sits in a deep hierarchy, such as a file browser, docs tree, or nested settings, where the trail changes as people move around.
limitations: Data-driven only: pass the whole trail as items. Collapsing hides a single run of middle segments. Fitting measures the nav's own width (full width by default), so keep it out of shrink-to-fit containers or turn collapseToFit off there. The last item is always the current page.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Give each item a label and an href (except the current page); pass renderLink to use a router link such as Next.js Link. Reduced motion swaps segments instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/breadcrumb.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
